task.title: Claimant’s reports have processed for the effective week of the new normal weekly hours (NWH) — No cycling claimant’s reports

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the client is exempt from reporting:
Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and in the Claimant’s Report section, rescind the exemption from reporting as follows:
Select the Project Data — Worksharing (M171) transaction and end the first WS period as follows:

ul.li: End date: Select the date that corresponds to the last week processed.

step.cmd: The next business day, in FTS, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign a registration number as follows:
Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to input a renewal week and, if rescinded in step 2, an exemption from reporting as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Renewal: Select the week that corresponds to the week following the last week processed.

Claimant’s Report — Claim Action: Select the appropriate option:
W - work-sharing - no claimant’s reports.
H - work-sharing with claimant’s reports.

step.cmd: Select the Project Data — Worksharing (M171) transaction and input the second WS period information as follows:

ul.li: Start date: Select the week that corresponds to the renewal week.
End date: Select the original WS agreement end week.
Project SCC: Enter the original SCC of the WS agreement.
Project number: Enter the original WS agreement number.
Weekly hours: Enter the new NWH. Include a 0 or a 5 at the end to indicate the hour or half hour. Do not include the decimal (e.g. 40 NWH are entered as 400 and 37.5 NWH are entered as 375).

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Message: Select 55 - Change to Worksharing/Job Creation .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Work item: Select 92 - Purge and Recreate .
Remarks line 1: Type “WS — change the NWH from [XX] to [XX] as of w/c [XXXX].”
Remarks line 2: Type “Change the start date of the current WS period to w/c [XXXX].”
Remarks line 3: Type “End the previous WS period one week before the start of the current WS period.”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Message: Select 55 - Change to Worksharing/Job Creation .

step.cmd: In NWS, create an SROC as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Work-Sharing — change in normal weekly hours.”

Details: Type “The program officer reports that normal weekly hours changed from [XX] to [XX] effective w/c [XXXX]. Work-Sharing employer [XXXX], Work-Sharing agreement number [XXXXXXX]. Ended current agreement period as of last week processed. New agreement period with new normal weekly hours has been input from the week following the last week processed — w/c [XXXX]. An Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction was sent to IPOC with the following information: Change the start date of the current Work-Sharing period to w/c [XXXX]. End the previous Work-Sharing period one week before the start of the current Work-Sharing period.”

step.cmd: No further action is required. Complete the WI, if necessary.
